texts.historicalContext: Leonardo portrayed the young Florentine Ginevra de’ Benci against a dense juniper bush.
texts.artisticAnalysis: Her direct presence and reserved expression replace conventional profile portraiture with psychological immediacy.
texts.composition: The pale face is framed by dark foliage, with water and landscape opening beyond.
texts.palette: Cool flesh, deep green and muted atmospheric blues create a quiet, concentrated mood.
texts.perspectiveTechnique: Soft modelling and aerial perspective connect the sitter to the distant world.
texts.culturalSignificance: The portrait helped establish a more intimate and observant Renaissance portrait tradition.
